label: Полицайите обявиха протест за 28 ноември — и отреха да са уведомявани за съкращенията (21 ноември)
text: СФСМВР chair Iliya Kuzmanov, speaking after the union's national meeting in Veliko Tarnovo, confirmed action in Sofia on Saturday 28 Nov at 12:00, jointly with the prison staff union, calling it a protest „за чест и достойнство“ rather than a pay protest — the offence, he said, is that security was dropped from the promised uniform income approach, and he argued a 5% rise would cost about €100m against a deficit discussed at €4.7bn. He also stated the federation has received no official or unofficial information on the scope, number or method of the announced cuts, and doubted a decision exists.
